name: When should I consider replacing or updating my home's exterior trim?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing or updating my home's exterior trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing or updating your exterior trim if you notice signs of deterioration such as cracking, peeling paint, rot, insect damage, or significant gaps. Ignoring these issues can lead to more extensive damage to your home's structure. Often, homeowners choose to update trim during a larger exterior renovation project, like residing or repainting, to ensure a cohesive look and long-term protection. We recommend an inspection if you notice any signs of decay, as addressing trim issues early can prevent more costly repairs down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace or update exterior trim if you observe cracking, rot, insect damage, or peeling paint to prevent structural issues. Many choose to update trim during larger exterior renovations for a cohesive and protective finish.
